name: @tn4consulting/shared-federation-runtime
description: RemoteRouteHost, RemoteModuleLoaderContext, PaymentHistoryWidgetLoaderContext, JobApplicationsWidgetLoaderContext, and EiReportingStatusWidgetLoaderContext -- the shared React Context patterns for safely loading federated modules. Every app repo converted to this major as of the family's completed React-only migration (2026-08); the last 0.x (Angular DI-token-shaped: REMOTE_MODULE_LOADER, REACT_MOUNTER, kind-discriminated widget loaders) major stays published only as a historical artifact.
